freeze_revision.reason: Pre-implementation code audit found that V31 conditional_forward uses constant endpoint extension outside the train-derived per-bin residual support. The coherent validation round trip must therefore distinguish support truncation from phase translation before either mechanism is assigned to the remaining Q3/Q4 and 2PCF failures.

purpose: Test whether the V31 conditional-copula donor transport fails because residual spectral amplitudes depend on target-free context and/or because translating a donor innovation destroys the query-aligned backbone-residual Fourier cross phase needed for the total-density 2PCF.

fourier_measurement.dc: subtract each field mean and exclude the Fourier DC mode
fourier_measurement.auto_power: sum |FFT(field)|^2 per band divided by the band mode count
fourier_measurement.cross_power: sum Re[FFT(backbone)*conj(FFT(residual))] per band divided by mode count

conditional_spectrum_audit.fit_rows: all development train cubes with exactly equal total sample weight per source
conditional_spectrum_audit.validation_rows: all development validation cubes, never used for fitting or early stopping
features: log backbone auto-power in each of the eight Fourier bands
log galaxy-count auto-power in each band
log mean-radial-velocity auto-power in each band
conditional_spectrum_audit.targets: log physical residual auto-power in each of the eight bands
conditional_spectrum_audit.constant_reference: equal-source train mean log residual power per band
conditional_spectrum_audit.supported: nonlinear/constant log-power validation RMSE <=0.90 in all three domains in at least two common bands

phase_translation_audit.objects: the exact 16 frozen V28/V31 development object source_index values in each domain
phase_translation_audit.coherent_control: u=F_train(r_truth|m), then r_control=F_train^-1(u|m), followed by exact residual-mean subtraction
phase_translation_audit.translated_transport: periodically roll the complete conditional quantile field u by scale*direction, invert it at the unchanged query backbone m, and subtract residual mean; this preserves the donor innovation pattern and marginal ranks while destroying only its alignment with the query
phase_translation_audit.reference: m plus the exact truth residual after the same residual-mean subtraction
measurements: fraction of validation voxels mapped to conditional CDF endpoints and coherent-control log10-density tail error
translated total-power ratio and absolute log10 power error per band
exact and translated backbone-residual cross-correlation per band
error as a function of translation scale
phase_translation_audit.phase_coupling_material: there is at least one common band below 6 h/Mpc where all domains have |exact backbone-residual cross-correlation|>=0.05 and the mean translated total-power absolute log10 error at either 2.5 or 5 Mpc/h is >=0.02 dex
phase_translation_audit.conditional_support_material: in any domain, either at least 1e-5 of validation voxels map exactly to u=0 or u=1 or the coherent-control maximum absolute reconstruction error exceeds 0.1 dex in log10 density (=4.5*y)

predeclared_interpretation.if_conditional_support_is_material: replace finite endpoint saturation with a train-only conditional tail likelihood or explicit extreme-value continuation; never use validation extrema, clipping, or post-hoc amplitude correction
predeclared_interpretation.if_spectrum_and_phase_supported: replace donor transport with a query-aligned conditional multiscale stochastic field model that jointly learns residual auto-covariance and backbone-residual cross-covariance
predeclared_interpretation.if_only_phase_supported: retain train residual spectral amplitudes but replace translated donor phases with a query-aligned joint conditional residual model
predeclared_interpretation.if_only_spectrum_supported: condition the stochastic residual band amplitudes on target-free context while retaining an independent phase innovation
predeclared_interpretation.if_neither_supported: do not add another density-field learner; audit the downstream 2PCF estimator and finite-ensemble gate implementation
